required_outcome: One real lead = exactly one Primary bidding conversion.
historical_data_preserved: Only primary_for_goal changes. Status stays ENABLED, no action is removed, and past conversions are not restated.

page_view_x2_cannot_be_resolved_by_api.finding: All five Google Business Profile (GOOGLE_HOSTED) conversion actions are system-managed and reject every mutate with mutate_error: MUTATE_NOT_ALLOWED. Verified individually by validate_only on 6954620053, 6640721230, 6641739327, 6642551975 and 6642544931 - all five REJECTED, while the two WhatConverts upload actions VALIDATED_OK.
affected: PAGE_VIEW x2 (6641739327 Website visits, 6954620053 Menu views)
page_view_x2_cannot_be_resolved_by_api.why_it_is_not_a_defect: Both sit on the PAGE_VIEW/GOOGLE_HOSTED customer conversion goal, which is already NON-BIDDABLE. They cannot influence Smart Bidding and report conversions = 0. The duplication is a reporting artefact with no bidding effect, and Google does not expose a way to change it.
page_view_x2_cannot_be_resolved_by_api.if_the_owner_wants_it_gone: It can only be changed in the Google Ads UI under Goals, or by unlinking the Google Business Profile. That is a separate decision and is NOT part of this plan.

goal_layer_finding.why_it_matters: The five Google Business Profile local-action Primaries sit on NON-BIDDABLE goals, so they never influenced bidding. Their duplication was cosmetic. The real defect was two WhatConverts upload actions sharing biddable goals with the native tags.

deliberate_deviation.item: PHONE_CALL_LEAD keeps two Primary actions, not one.
deliberate_deviation.why: 1068114183 (AD_CALL, origin CALL_FROM_ADS) and 6885576934 (WEBSITE_CALL, origin WEBSITE) cannot both fire for the same interaction: a caller who taps the ad's call asset never reaches the website, and a caller who dials a number on the page did not use the ad's call asset. They are two distinct lead events on two distinct biddable goals. Collapsing them to one would stop counting a real lead type. The binding requirement - one real lead equals exactly one Primary bidding conversion - is fully satisfied.

reversible: Each change is a single primary_for_goal boolean and can be set back.
